new-york-city.party: 2 adults + 2 kids, ages 5 and 8; height, not age, decides who rides alone

new-york-city.subhead: Mount Peter, Campgaw, Mountain Creek, Camelback and Blue Mountain: the minimum height to ride alone, when a small child can ride with you, and what a session costs, from each park's own page.

answer.label: Weekend tubing for 4 at Mount Peter
answer.basis: 4 tickets × $49 (weekend or holiday, 90-minute session, 2026–27 rates) · every tuber needs a ticket, even a child riding with you · estimate · prices read Nov 24.

bullets.label: Under 36 inches
bullets.text: has a Little Tikes hill for the smallest kids, with an attendant at the top

bullets.label: From 33 inches
bullets.text: lets a child ride a double tube with an adult; 44 inches to ride alone

bullets.label: Closest to the city
bullets.text: but every rider must be 48 inches or taller, with no double tubes

bullets.label: After dark
bullets.text: sessions after 5 p.m. add colored lights and music

picks.label: Toddler under 36 inches
picks.why: Its Little Tikes hill is for kids under 36 inches, reached by a carpet lift.

picks.label: Preschooler riding with you
picks.why: Double tubes from 33 inches at Camelback and 36 inches at Mountain Creek and Mount Peter.

picks.label: Kids 48 inches and up, short drive
picks.why: About 24 miles from Midtown in a straight line; $39 a weekend session.

picks.label: Biggest park
picks.why: It calls itself the USA's largest snow tubing park, with up to 56 lanes.

picks.label: Cheapest weekend we could price
picks.why: $156 for 4 at Campgaw if everyone is 48 inches; $196 at Mount Peter with no height floor for the Little Tikes hill.

pages: skiing near New York City with kids

hills.name: Mount Peter
hills.where: Warwick, NY · about 38 miles from Midtown in a straight line
hills.getting_there: Drive; the park says it is about an hour from New York City. Arrive 30 minutes before your session to park, buy tickets and sign waivers.
kids: 42 inches to ride alone; 36 to 41 inches in a double tube with a parent or guardian
Under 36 inches: the Little Tikes hill, with an attendant at the top; kids under 8 need an adult with them there
Every tuber needs a ticket, and so does any adult who goes into the Little Tikes area
90-minute sessions; book online, sessions can sell out
price_rows: Weekend or holiday session, per person
hills.price_note: 2026–27 rates on its tubing page; all tickets include the snow play area.

hills.name: Campgaw Mountain
hills.where: Mahwah, NJ · about 24 miles from Midtown in a straight line
hills.getting_there: Drive; its tubing page gives no transit option.
kids: 48 inches or taller (hat off) to ride, no exceptions; no double tubes
Each rider carries their own tube; a parent can't haul a child's tube too
2-hour sessions; tickets go on sale 14 days ahead; a signed waiver is needed for every rider
hills.price_note: Rates on its tubing page, which names no season. Changes less than 48 hours ahead cost $10 a ticket; no-shows pay in full.

card_figure.small: weekend session for 4 if everyone is 48 inches, estimate

hills.name: Mountain Creek
hills.where: Vernon, NJ · about 40 miles from Midtown in a straight line
hills.getting_there: Drive; park in the Vernon general lot by Cobblestone Village, where the tubing entrance is.
kids: 42 inches to ride alone; 36 to 42 inches in a double tube or linked to a responsible adult
2-hour sessions starting when your code is scanned
Tickets online only, in advance; no sales at the hill
hills.price_note: 2026–27 prices aren't posted yet; its page still shows last season as closed (read Nov 24). Tickets can't be refunded.

hills.name: Camelback Resort
hills.where: Tannersville, PA · about 75 miles from Midtown in a straight line
hills.getting_there: Drive to the Poconos; arrive at least 30 minutes before your session.
kids: 44 inches to ride alone; 33 to 43 inches in a double tube or chain with an adult 18 or older; under 33 inches can't ride
Riders under 14 need a participating adult with them
2-hour sessions starting on the hour; each rider needs their own ticket on their own RFID card
hills.price_note: No prices on its page; they show only when you pick a date and time, and it says prices can change with demand.
hills.table_price: Shown by date when you book

hills.name: Blue Mountain Resort
hills.where: Palmerton, PA · about 80 miles from Midtown in a straight line
hills.getting_there: Drive; the tubing park is at the Valley Lodge at the bottom of the mountain.
kids: 36 inches or taller to ride; no age or weight limits; single or double tubes
Everyone, kids included, needs their own named ticket; a parent signs the waiver for under-18s
2-hour sessions; after 5 p.m. the park adds colored lights and music
hills.price_note: 2026–27 tickets are on sale, priced by date and time on its booking page; the page lists no dollar amounts.
hills.table_price: Shown by date when you book
